generation.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: an original illustrated mage character portrait for a professional portfolio designed as a fantasy RPG recruitment menu. Input image 1 is an identity reference ONLY: depict the same man, preserving his recognizable face shape, short brown hair and hairline, neatly trimmed brown beard with a few grey hairs, grey-blue eyes, rectangular dark-framed glasses, adult age and friendly calm expression. Change clothing and setting into fantasy; do not copy the office or black hoodie. Character: an approachable, skilled human mage, wearing a beautifully painted deep petrol-blue robe with warm ochre lining, aged brass clasps, a practical leather belt and a modest spellbook; one hand holding a wooden staff with a small luminous turquoise crystal, the other relaxed. No hat and no hood over his head: hair, glasses and face remain fully visible. Style: polished hand-painted fantasy illustration with the rich warm/cool colors, expressive brushwork and charming material shapes associated with Bastion, but an original character, not a copy of a game character. Painterly rather than photorealistic or 3D, restrained details, clearly recognizable facial likeness. Composition: vertical, knees-up three-quarter portrait, face turned toward the viewer, character centered, entire head and staff ornament visible with comfortable margin, crisp readable silhouette. Lighting: warm golden key light and subtle cool teal rim light; readable on both a dark and a moderately lit background. Background: genuinely transparent alpha, isolated character, no scenery, no frame, no opaque fill, no checkerboard painted into the image. No letters, text, logo, watermark, UI, extra people, exaggerated physique or threatening expression. Keep the face and glasses faithful to the reference. Intended as a reusable illustration layer, not an entire website mockup.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original wide background artwork for a professional portfolio that feels like a fantasy RPG menu; reusable base layer for subtle animation and day/evening/night lighting in CSS. Scene: a welcoming mage's workshop in the quiet corner of an old tavern, beautifully hand-painted stone archways, dark carved wood, a few books, softly glowing lanterns, a broad arched window looking out at a luminous blue-green fantasy landscape and a small inviting open floor area. No people or creatures. Visual direction: rich painterly colors and charming expressive brushwork inspired by Bastion, original architecture and props, not copied game assets; clear atmospheric depth and calm composition, not grim realistic medieval horror. Palette: deep petrol blue and muted moss green, warm ochre and amber lights, hints of soft coral, cream stone highlights. Composition: wide landscape approximately 16:9, dark low-detail negative space across the LEFT forty percent and center for a complete readable navigation list and content panels; the beautiful arched window, architecture and environmental detail concentrated toward the right side. This is consistent with a left menu and right character portrait. Lower center remains unobstructed enough for a later optional small interaction area. Overall background substantially darker than a white portfolio website, but with visible welcoming colors and luminous highlights, not near-black everywhere. Lighting is soft, neutral late-afternoon ambient with warm lanterns, so the same artwork can be tinted for day, dusk and night. Keep geometry crisp but background detail subdued. No baked-in menus, buttons, text, letters, branding, frames, characters, foreground mage or huge magic spell effects. High quality illustration, not a screenshot, not pixel art, not a 3D render.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: standalone decorative fantasy prop illustration to complement an RPG menu portrait and a hand-painted tavern-workshop background. Create one beautiful small levitating arcane stone, roughly an irregular faceted cube of blue-grey stone with weathered edges, a thin aged-brass band and a few delicate turquoise magical cracks. A very restrained soft turquoise glow close to the stone, readable rock material, warm ochre light on one edge. Original hand-painted fantasy art with expressive brushwork, rich colors and charming material shapes reminiscent of Bastion, not realistic photographic 3D. Clear simple silhouette, centered in a square composition with generous empty margin. It should feel like a craftable building block for a friendly mage, not a jewel, orb or weapon. Genuinely transparent background with actual alpha, no environment, floor, pedestal, cast floor shadow, frame, lettering, recognizable glyphs, logo, watermark or painted checkerboard. One single stone only, no sheet, no multiple variations. The soft glow must remain contained near the object for use over both lighter and darker panels.
